_doc: 美术资产清单 = 唯一真相源。tools/art_audit.gd 据此列出缺失资产并生成提示词；tools/import_art.gd 据此把 art_inbox/ 里的图片处理成游戏资产。新增基因部件/骨架/生态区/状态/卡牌时必须在这里补规格，test_data 会检查。mode: palette=灰度绘制+运行时按种族上色（饱和色区域=发光强调色）；mono=白色剪影图标（运行时着色）；color=保留原色；cutout=保留原色但去背景。

style.part: 2D game asset for a creature-assembly game, dark biological fantasy, forbidden naturalist bestiary style, single isolated creature part, side view facing right, monochrome grayscale value painting, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, thick uniform near-black outline around the whole shape, clean readable silhouette, centered and filling most of the frame with a small margin, plain flat pure white background
style.body: 2D game asset for a creature-assembly game, dark biological fantasy, forbidden naturalist bestiary style, full body of a creature in its plain base form, side view facing right, neutral idle pose, monochrome grayscale value painting, flat cel shading with one soft highlight, thick uniform near-black outline, whole body visible and filling most of the frame with a small margin, feet near the bottom, no weapons, no accessories, no extra organs, plain flat pure white background
style.icon: flat game UI icon, one bold simple solid white silhouette symbol, centered, chunky shapes readable at 32 pixels, plain flat pure black background, no outline color, no gradient, no border, no text
style.background: 2D side-view game battle background, dark biological fantasy, painterly, muted desaturated colors, horizon in the upper third, wide calm flat ground band across the middle and lower half where creatures will stand, darker and low-contrast in the center, atmospheric depth, no characters, no creatures, no text, no UI
style.illustration: dark biological fantasy illustration, forbidden naturalist bestiary page, ink outlines with painterly color, muted parchment tones with bioluminescent accents, readable silhouette, no text, no watermark
style.ui: dark biological fantasy game UI element, aged parchment, bone and dark chitin, ink line details, flat front view, no text
style.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, gore, blood splatter, text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, multiple objects, scene, background details, cast shadow, frame, cropped, blurry, low contrast outline
style.negative_color_ok: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, gore, text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry
style.accent_clause: Only {accent} glow in a bright saturated green; everything else stays strictly grayscale.
style.no_accent_clause: No glowing or colored areas at all; strictly grayscale.
style.style_cn: 【中文风格锁定，可用于即梦/通义万相/可灵等】2D 游戏素材，暗黑生物幻想，禁忌博物志画风，单个独立物件，侧视朝右，单色灰度明暗绘画，平涂赛璐璐加一处柔和高光，整体有粗细均匀的近黑色描边，轮廓清晰，居中留白，纯白色平底背景，无文字、无投影、无边框。
